facts.text: Mountain Lake Park was founded in 1881 as Maryland's original Chautauqua resort along the B&O Railroad.
The town hosts the historic Bashford Amphitheater, built in 1900, whose ticket office now houses a museum with memorabilia dating back to 1881.
In 2021 the Victorian Chautauqua was revived, kicking off a modern reimagining of the original 1881 summer festival.
The Mountain Lake Park Historical Association preserves over 500 images and archived films that document the town’s rise to national acclaim at the turn of the last century.
Mountain Lake Park once housed the only African American congregation in Garrett County, the Bethel A.M.E. Church, which was restored and relocated to the town.
